ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data

promise_gap: Ad: 'Switch to clean energy with Varna Solar featuring WAAREE solar panels.' / 'Government subsidy of up to Rs.78,000 for eligible households.'

Backed. The site's JSON-LD advertises exactly three services - Residential Rooftop Solar, Commercial & Industrial Solar Power Plants and Solar Water Pumping Systems - and the Rs.78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy appears in the meta description too.
Ad: 'Thinking of installing rooftop solar at your home?'

The click never reaches the page that answers this. The ad goes to WhatsApp (confirmed on the card), and the homepage is a client-rendered React SPA whose served HTML contains no H1, no contact form and no calculator - the 'Calculate Your Savings' link points at /solar-calculator, which is only populated after JavaScript runs.
Ad: 'Reduce Your Electricity Bills with Varna Solar Hyderabad!'
The site's CTA is 'Get Free Site Survey' -> /#contact, a React section that is not in the served HTML at all, so a visitor who arrives from a search cannot find it without JavaScript.
